name: 55 DOMINOES (DOUBLE-9)
description: 55 dominoes (double-9) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: 55 dominoes (double-9) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.
Double-9 set (55 tiles, 0-0 through 9-9). Block/draw dominoes; same matching rules as double-6. More players or longer games possible.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
--

items.text: Double-9 block game: Standard double-9 block dominoes: players draw a starting hand from the 55-tile set, no further tiles are drawn during play, and the first to empty hand or hold the fewest pips when blocked wins.

Double-9 draw game: Double-9 draw dominoes: players draw tiles from the boneyard whenever they cannot play to an open end until the stock is exhausted, then pass; the winner is the first out or the lowest pip total when blocked.
Partnership double-9: Partnership version for four players seated in pairs, using the same double-9 set and block or draw rules but scoring and winning as teams instead of individuals.
